name: g74_pass_confused
purpose: Baton Pass (decision 0042): Espeon (M) raises Calm Mind (+1 SpA, +1 SpD) on turn 1, and Umbreon (M) Alluring Voice hits it the same turn (the confusion of a target whose stats rose this turn), so Espeon is confused. On turn 2 Espeon passes (no self-hit this seed) to Ninetales (M), the first standing reserve. The receiver inherits the boost stages and the confusion counter with no line for the copy. Its own Nasty Plot then adds to the inherited stages on turn 3.
